topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution, cellular origins, and microenvironmental interactions alongside the session learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic Selection and Epigenetic Drivers of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer clones evolve and gain competitive fitness through both Darwinian selection of driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic reprogramming.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the evidence for hierarchical cancer stem cell organization and bottom-up transformation across leukemia and colorectal models.

topics.label: Inflammatory and Microenvironmental Promotion of Tumor Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental exposure and chronic inflammatory signaling provide the permissive cues necessary to promote pre-neoplastic mutant cells into tumors.

topics.label: Established Tumor Microenvironments, Spatial Profiling, and Evolutionary Summary
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine stromal codependency in established tumors, the spatial omics technologies used to resolve tumor-microenvironment interactions, and the overall synthesis of cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
